excerpt: The KArlsruhe TRItium Neutrino (KATRIN) experiment, presently being performed at Tritium Laboratory Karlsruhe on the KIT Campus North site. The international partnership consists of more than 150 scientists, engineers, technicians and students from 12 institutions in Germany, the United Kingdom, the Czech Republic and the United States.
